title: Vietnamese Grilled Pork with Sweet Simmered Nems
description: A fusion dish featuring grilled pork, sweet simmered nems, and crispy guanciale. Perfect for a summer evening.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, honey, lime juice, grated ginger, and minced garlic.
Add the pork shoulder to the marinade and let it sit for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the pork from the marinade and grill for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, simmer the nems in a mixture of water and soy sauce until tender.
Crisp the guanciale in a pan over medium heat.
Slice the grilled pork and serve with sweet simmered nems and crispy guanciale.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
